name: 94086 · Sunnyvale, CA
findings: ZIP 94086 (Sunnyvale) has 105 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94086 (Sunnyvale) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 94086 (Sunnyvale) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
